name: vault
description: Hybrid knowledge vault for Claude Code — auto-archives sessions into an Obsidian-compatible wiki, split between a global (~/Global Claude Vault/) vault and per-project (docs/vault/) vaults. At session start, vault context (index, project entity, recent sessions) is automatically injected so Claude can reference past decisions and lessons without re-discovering them. Builds on the LLM-Wiki pattern by Selma Kocabıyık.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import pathlib,subprocess,sys,os,shutil; plugin=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT','')); vault=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_VAULT',str(pathlib.Path.home()/'Global Claude Vault'))); scan_src=plugin/'scripts'/'scan-sessions.py'; scan_dst=vault/'scripts'/'scan-sessions.py'; scan_dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) or (shutil.copy(str(scan_src),str(scan_dst)) if scan_src.exists() and not scan_dst.exists() else None); p=plugin/'scripts'/'vault-context.py'; subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p),str(vault)]) if p.exists() else None" 2>/dev/null || python -c "import pathlib,subprocess,sys,os,shutil; plugin=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT','')); vault=pathlib.Path(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_VAULT',str(pathlib.Path.home()/'Global Claude Vault'))); scan_src=plugin/'scripts'/'scan-sessions.py'; scan_dst=vault/'scripts'/'scan-sessions.py'; scan_dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True) or (shutil.copy(str(scan_src),str(scan_dst)) if scan_src.exists() and not scan_dst.exists() else None); p=plugin/'scripts'/'vault-context.py'; subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p),str(vault)]) if p.exists() else None"
